questions_for_advisor: This closes the legibility half of ARCH-20260920-004's finding, but not the finding itself. The reason a zero-lookup override was misread is now gone from the string; the reason a zero-lookup override HAPPENS is B16, and it is open. A reader of a fresh trace will now see 'citation demand detected; 0 deferred gap(s) — nothing to look up' and correctly conclude that nothing was verified — and the next question they will ask is why the grounding phase deferred no blocking gap on a plan that demands citations. That question has no row yet.

Recorded because the shape keeps recurring: this is the fourth instrument this session whose output said less than it observed — after the 429 body, the .env comparison, and the n=5 count. In every case the code was right and its report was not. Worth considering whether that belongs in §4.4 as a convention rather than as four separate incident notes.
public_safe_summary: verify_grounding's detail string now names detection, deferred gaps and whether a lookup happened as three separate clauses, and the stem 'verif-' is gone from every emitted path. A zero-gap override reads 'nothing to look up, no lookup performed' rather than 'criteria demand verifiability; 0 finding(s)', which is what misled the executor's own reading of its own traces. It also distinguishes a run with nothing to look up from one whose lookup returned nothing — a distinction the old string could not make. Behaviour is unchanged, no test pinned the old text, and the suite is unmoved at 744.
